method: F2 with a vocabulary of variants carried by at least three training samples. Select by ROC AUC on three patient-grouped inner folds, then fit Platt scaling on raw out-of-fold scores from those folds and derive the golden thresholds from the calibrated scores. Refit using the entire golden cohort and evaluate on KMVALIDATION2025.
caveats: Research use only. The selected settings and Platt calibration use the same inner folds. The outer and KM results are held-out evaluations. KM is a sensitivity analysis with undocumented assay and critical concentration, medium-quality phenotypes, and few resistant isolates. Sensitivity at fixed specificity describes the held-out ROC curve.
